name: The Games We Play
source:
Ezra's girlfriend has cheated on him.

This presents issues for his tabletop roleplaying game group, as he is now too angry to concentrate on their game. So his friends talk with him instead, and they hatch a horrible plan, a cruel joke of an idea. Why not sleep with her father to get back at her?

Ezra quickly dismisses this idea, yet when his ex's dad texts him out of the blue, he is surprised to find out that they have more in common than they could ever have imagined. Maybe this isn't such a bad idea after all?

[From [url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/the-games-we-play]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以斯拉的女朋友背叛了他。

这给他的桌面角色扮演游戏小组带来了问题，因为他现在太生气了，无法专注于他们的游戏。于是他的朋友们与他交谈，他们制定了一个可怕的计划，一个残酷的笑话。为什么不和她父亲睡觉来报复她呢？

以斯拉很快就驳回了这个想法，然而，当他前任的父亲突然给他发短信时，他惊讶地发现他们的共同点比他们想象的要多。也许这毕竟不是一个坏主意？

[来自[url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/the-games-we-play]itch.io[/url]]
